{{Short description|Mathematical optimization problem for bus and rail transport}}
The '''transit route network design problem''' is a [[mathematical optimization]] problem in the context of [[Transportation network (graph theory)|transportation networks]] with well-defined stops, routes and timetables such as [[bus]] and [[railway]] networks.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Kepaptsoglou |first1=Konstantinos |last2=Karlaftis |first2=Matthew |date=2009-08-01 |title=Transit Route Network Design Problem: Review |url=https://ascelibrary.org/doi/10.1061/(ASCE)0733-947X(2009)135:8(491) |journal=Journal of Transportation Engineering |language=EN |volume=135 |issue=8 |pages=491–505 |doi=10.1061/(ASCE)0733-947X(2009)135:8(491) |issn=0733-947X}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Bertsimas |first1=Dimitris |last2=Ng |first2=Yee Sian |last3=Yan |first3=Julia |date=2021-02-17 |title=Data-Driven Transit Network Design at Scale |url=https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/opre.2020.2057 |journal=Operations Research |language=en |volume=69 |issue=4 |pages=1118–1133 |doi=10.1287/opre.2020.2057 |issn=0030-364X|url-access=subscription |hdl=1721.1/144080 |hdl-access=free }}</ref>

The problem can be broken down into five subproblems: [[transportation network design]], [[frequency setting]], [[timetable development]], [[vehicle scheduling]], and [[crew scheduling]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Park |first1=Su Jin |last2=Kang |first2=Seungmo |last3=Byon |first3=Young-Ji |last4=Kho |first4=Seung-Young |date=2022-10-07 |title=Multiobjective Approach to the Transit Network Design Problem with Variable Demand considering Transit Equity |journal=Journal of Advanced Transportation |language=en |volume=2022 |issue=1 |article-number=5887985 |doi=10.1155/2022/5887985 |doi-access=free |issn=2042-3195}}</ref>
